payload.title: Prevent stale phase-output reuse in retrieval performance timeout reporting
payload.summary: P2 experiment-owned measurement correctness. experiments/performance/retrieval/profiler.py:profile reads a pre-existing phases/<phase>.json after CommandTimeoutError without checking current invocation identity or worker entry. Independent fake executor times out before entry with old COMPLETE output present: returned TIME_LIMIT_STOPPED_NOT_REPEATED retains the old summary and a999-second lower bound despite a120-second cap. reporting.render prefers any summary, so stale timing can appear as current stopped-phase data. No original performance result shown corrupted.
payload.benefit: Keep frozen original profiler/output immutable. Future maintained/versioned engineering entry must bind phase outputs to an exact fresh invocation or refuse pre-existing output; timeout before authenticated worker entry must report unknown/lower-bound0 without carrying old samples/summary. Permanent independent tests: stale complete/partial/foreign phase, timeout before entry, fresh heartbeat then timeout, normal complete, nonzero worker failure, one invocation/no retry. Preserve120-second bound, no science replay or ambiguous external-effect retry. Real consumers are engineering profile publication and reporting only.
payload.uncertainty: Original retained stopped phase has no stale summary and a bound within its cap; current source demonstration does not invalidate that run. A new generic journal, lifecycle controller or framework tracing layer is unnecessary. Suitable report-only maintenance-agent scope.
